title: Personal Credit Cards: cash advance fee and limit, foreign transaction fee and over-limit tolerance by tier
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: cash advance, foreign transaction and over-limit figures

This fee card covers the Personal Credit Cards line. It lists, for every card tier, the cash advance fee and its minimum, the share of the credit limit that cash advances may use in one statement cycle, the foreign transaction fee, and how far above the credit limit purchases are still authorized.

## Tier table

| Card tier | Cash advance fee, percent of each advance | Minimum cash advance fee | Cash advances per cycle, percent of credit limit | Foreign transaction fee | Purchases authorized above the limit by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 5.00% | 10.00 USD | 20% | 3.00% | 0% |
| College Rewards Visa | 5.00% | 10.00 USD | 20% | 3.00% | 0% |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 5.00% | 10.00 USD | 30% | 3.00% | 5% |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 5.00% | 10.00 USD | 30% | 3.00% | 5% |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 5.00% | 10.00 USD | 30% | 0.00% | 10% |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 5.00% | 10.00 USD | 40% | 0.00% | 10% |

## What the columns mean

- **Cash advance fee and minimum**: the cash advance fee as a percent of each advance, and the minimum fee per advance.
- **Cash advances per cycle**: cash advances posted in one statement cycle may not exceed this percent of the credit limit.
- **Foreign transaction fee**: the fee on each purchase made outside the United States or in a foreign currency, as a percent.
- **Over-limit tolerance**: purchases are authorized up to this percent above the credit limit, and no over-limit fee is ever charged.

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical credit limit of 2000.00 USD)

| Card tier | Cash advances allowed in one cycle | Balance up to which purchases are authorized |
|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa or College Rewards Visa | up to 400.00 USD | 2000.00 USD, the limit itself |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa or Cash Rewards Visa | up to 600.00 USD | 2100.00 USD |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | up to 600.00 USD | 2200.00 USD |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | up to 800.00 USD | 2200.00 USD |

Each figure is the hypothetical limit multiplied by the tier percentage, or the limit increased by the tier percentage for the purchase column.

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Which tiers charge no foreign transaction fee?**
A: Travel Rewards Visa Signature and Visa Infinite Private Client, whose foreign transaction fee is 0.00%.

**Q: Is there ever an over-limit fee?**
A: No. The tolerance column only widens authorization; no over-limit fee is charged on any tier.
